title: Parent candidate table exhaustion allows DoS on new nodes
description:
## Location
rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs lines 390-394

## Issue
The parent candidate table is capped at `MAX_PARENT_CANDIDATES = 16`. New candidates are silently rejected when at capacity:
```rust
} else if self.parents.len() < MAX_PARENT_CANDIDATES {
    self.parents.insert(neighbor_addr, candidate);
}
// else: at capacity with a new parent -> reject silently
```

## Attack scenario
An attacker floods an unjoined node with 16 fake DIOs (different source addresses, valid params). The table fills with attacker-controlled entries. When the legitimate root or valid parents send DIOs, they are silently rejected.

## Mitigating factors
- Existing entries can be updated (line 388-389), so once a valid parent is in the table, it stays
- Attacker would need to be first 16 DIOs a node receives
- Link-layer authentication (Schnorr) may prevent spoofing

## Suggested mitigations
1. Consider eviction policy based on link quality (replace worst candidate)
2. Or: rate-limit new candidate insertions
3. Document this as a known limitation with operational guidance (ensure valid DIOs reach nodes before attackers)
